fluff.overview: Reforms begun under Alessandro Steiner and reinforced by Federated Suns influence have integrated Lyran infantry into combined-arms operations more effectively than at any point in the Commonwealth's history. Mechanized wheeled platoons use wheeled APCs that offer a balance between the speed of hover transport and the protection of tracked vehicles, well-suited to operations on developed road networks. Armed with standard ballistic assault rifles, these platoons deliver reliable short-range firepower and can be equipped and resupplied from almost any garrison stockpile.
